verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is indirect. A Bitbucket integration listing says it syncs Asana 'custom fields', which implies custom fields exist in Asana, but nothing documents a product manager creating or configuring them. The 'status updates' items cover project status reports rather than customizable workflow statuses, so they don't support this story. Missing for 10: first-party docs on creating and editing custom fields, configurable workflow statuses or stages, process-specific customization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
